name: Drug-resistant receptor tyrosine kinase mutants
reason: FLT3 is a receptor tyrosine kinase, so drug-resistant FLT3 mutants are a subset of drug-resistant RTK mutants. All three pathways describe receptor tyrosine kinase mutants (KIT, PDGFR, ALK) resistant to drugs, fitting the parent theme.

name: Mismatch repair and double-strand break repair
reason: Homologous recombination repair is a specific mechanism of double-strand break repair, fully falling under the parent category. All listed pathways relate to mismatch repair defects or double-strand break repair/response, matching the parent theme.

name: Base excision repair
reason: The glycosylase step is a specific sub-step entirely within base excision repair, so it is fully covered. All three pathways relate to base excision repair biology, including depyrimidination which is a form of DNA damage addressed by this repair pathway.

name: DNA replication initiation and elongation
reason: Licensing is a pre-initiation step distinct from initiation and elongation, making this cluster broader than the parent rather than a strict subset. All three pathways directly concern DNA replication initiation or elongation processes, matching the parent theme.

name: Cardiac action potential generation and conduction
reason: Cardiac conduction system electrical propagation is a sub-process fully encompassed by cardiac action potential generation and conduction. All three pathways relate to cardiac action potential generation and conduction, matching the parent theme.

name: Blood coagulation cascade and its defects
reason: Defective coagulation factor variants causing bleeding disorders are a direct subset of blood coagulation cascade defects. All listed pathways relate directly to coagulation cascade processes or their defects, fitting the parent theme.

name: TGF-beta/BMP-SMAD signalling
reason: The regulation of TGF-beta/BMP-SMAD signalling is a sub-category fully contained within the parent pathway. All three pathways concern SMAD-mediated TGF-beta/BMP signal transduction and thus fall under the parent theme.

name: Complement activation and humoral defence

name: Heart morphogenesis and chamber development
reason: Cardiac septation and outflow tract morphogenesis is a subset of heart morphogenesis and chamber development processes. All listed pathways concern heart morphogenesis, chamber development, or related cardiac tissue development, fitting the parent theme.

name: Cytokine-JAK-STAT signaling
reason: IL-6/gp130-JAK-STAT3 signaling is a specific sub-pathway of cytokine-JAK-STAT signaling, fully contained within it. All listed pathways relate to cytokine signaling and/or JAK-STAT pathway activity, fitting within the Cytokine-JAK-STAT signaling theme.
